up: List all approved drugs indicated for neoplasm. For each drug, return the following information: the ChEMBL ID of the drug molecule, the preferred name of the drug, the canonical SMILES structure, the indication ID (mesh_id), the indication label (mesh_heading), and the maximum phase for that specific indication (max_phase_for_ind). Include all drugs associated with the specified disease indication.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  di.mesh_id,
  di.mesh_heading,
  di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM drug_indication di
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE di.mesh_heading LIKE '%neoplasm%';
